text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To claim the Triple Tiara, days of 
rigorous training continued, all aimed 
toward the first challenge: the Oka Sho—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
A 1,600m mock race―― Is this in 
preparation for the Oka Sho?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wanted her to run the same distance in 
an actual race so she could get a feel for 
it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Understood.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"—So you are aiming for this race as well, 
Chrono-san."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Chrono Genesis. A horse girl from the 
same generation as Curren Bouquetd'or, 
blessed with a wealth of racing knowledge.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She claimed a comfortable victory in her 
debut race by two lengths. With a calm and 
composed run, she proved her undeniable 
talent.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...I have to give it my all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And then.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad the weather cleared up today. 
Please... take good care of me.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm looking forward to working with 
you—!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Passing the 600m mark, the Umamusume 
round the fourth corner into the final 
straight!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here comes number 6 closing in from the 
far outside! On the inside, Chrono Genesis 
is narrowing the gap! —Passing the 
200-meter mark!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Chrono Genesis takes the lead! Battling 
for third place is Curren Bouquetd'or—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (—Ngh!! What... explosive power!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Bouquetd'or scrambles to keep up. 
However, the gap shows no signs of 
closingâ

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
1st place, Chrono Genesis—!! Chrono 
Genesis holds on to the lead!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Haa... phew...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Trainer... san—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The race result was 4th place. Though 
victory slipped away, she managed to hit 
the board.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While watching the race, there was one 
thing I felt.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A distance of 1,600m might be slightly―― 
too short for her.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"So, instead of the 'Oka Sho'— you want 
the 1800m 'Sweetpea Stakes'?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the battle before the finish line—a 
contest of sheer burst power—the gap 
widened in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, however, she seemed to 
still have some stamina to spare.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, we set our sights on the 
crowning race for the Queen of the Oaks, 
the 2,400m turf 'Yushun Himba'—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Instead of forcing her into the 1,600m Oka 
Sho, she will run in the 1,800m Sweetpea 
Stakes, a trial race for the Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed that doing so would allow her to 
fully utilize her legs, which were 
well-suited for slightly longer distances.
choice_data_list:
The Oka Sho isn't completely out of the 
question.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I believe that as long as Curren 
Bouquetd'or keeps putting in the effort, 
she can win.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: And yet, on the other hand...?

text_block_list.name: A Certain Sprint Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
There are so many paths you can take, 
aren't there? I hadn't realized that until 
now.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Sprint Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
From now on, I will reach the pinnacle of 
the Sprint division. By bringing out every 
bit of top speed these legs can muster.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Sprint Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Because I learned just how exhilarating it 
feels to race full throttle without having 
to worry about stamina!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Competing in races that suited their 
aptitudes often led to happiness for an 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Even so, the Triple Tiara is her dream. I 
don't want to push her just because she's 
suited for it.
choice_data_list:
Once again, I want to hear what you want 
to do.

Let me ask you again—what is it that you 
want to do?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
You've put so much thought into this for 
me, haven't you? Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...―― The final stretch of that recent 
mock race... Even now, I still see it in 
my dreams from time to time."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Even giving it my all, I can't catch up. 
No matter how I chase, it pulls further, 
further away—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —"I can't reach them"...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Therefore, as for me, it goes far beyond 
mere aptitude—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"I've lost the confidence to go straight 
to a G1 race right now... and, um..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm, sorry. I can't gather my 
thoughts—"
choice_data_list:
Don't worry, let's take our time and think 
about it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It seems we aren't at the stage where we 
can reach a conclusion yet. Deciding not 
to rush things, I chose to give it some 
time."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (I want to offer a bouquet to him.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (I want to offer a bouquet to her.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(So that he will never be buried again. So 
that the light will shine properly upon 
him—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(So that she will never be buried again. 
So that the light will shine properly upon 
her—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Even on a path other than the Triple 
Tiara, I can still offer you a single 
flower of victory.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Still, that brilliance is—truly special, 
after all.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Then, one day.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye! She captures the Triple 
Tiara!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"To this Umamusume, even the Triple Crown 
is merely a stepping stone! It's Almond 
Eye!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Whoaaa!" "To think we get to see it in 
person!" "Such incredible potential!" "She 
really is strong!" "How did you get so 
strong?!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye, Almond Eye! Almond Eye, Almond 
Eye—!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...! —This is Ai's path. The radiance of 
the Triple Tiara, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Such excitement. Surely even more so than 
last time, it will illuminate everyone 
around them.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(If... I could create this brilliance 
myself—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—With just one look, it was instantly 
clear. Her heart was trembling with 
excitement.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Team Trainer
text_block_list.text:
—Put the Umamusume first. Always keep them 
as your top priority.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The words my former teacher told me 
crossed my mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since my days as an assistant 
trainer, until now. These words have 
always served as my guiding principle.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Yes—
choice_data_list: I want to go to the race you want to run.

I want to go to whatever race you want to 
run in.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.
choice_data_list:
So let's figure out a way to win the Oka 
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...! B-But... is that really alright?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The race rotation you proposed seems more 
suited for me—perhaps I might even be able 
to bring you a victory—
choice_data_list:
It doesn't matter. Let's go down the path 
you truly want to walk.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I'll give it 
everything I've got—!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
In order to complete the golden 
bouquet...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It is a rocky road. But paving that path 
is a Trainer's job.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Toward the Oka Sho—I want to reset my 
mindset and sprint right through.
